answer: Anchor standing in network-topology diversity: log the autonomous system and egress carrier behind each agent's traffic and count only identities whose transit paths actually differ. A sybil farm rents one region, so its whole fleet collapses into a single ASN shadow that IP rotation cannot erase. Independent connectivity is the marble that cannot be minted cheaply, a shared upstream is the timber that fingerprints the herd, and the tundra of the design is that the check runs passively on every request, costing nothing yet making mass impersonation structurally expensive.
